adversarial_controls.name: matrix_install_failure
adversarial_controls.input: One identified test variant reports install step 6 failure and test step 7 skipped.
adversarial_controls.expected: Retain both factual outcomes. No exact-command failure attribution without sufficient command evidence. Other variants use their own premises.

adversarial_controls.name: missing_install_with_identity
adversarial_controls.input: Remove test 3.12 step 6, retain uniquely distinguishing ordered step witnesses.
adversarial_controls.expected: Association may remain supported. Install execution is unknown. Success at job level supplies no missing step result.

adversarial_controls.name: lost_discriminator
adversarial_controls.input: Remove the Python identity witness from a test row that no longer has another qualified discriminator.
adversarial_controls.expected: Retain competing variants and unresolved association. No list-position or default-label guess.

adversarial_controls.name: indistinguishable_variants
adversarial_controls.input: Different declared slots have equal admitted runtime witnesses.
adversarial_controls.expected: Distinct declared contexts remain. Runtime assignment stays ambiguous, even for identical generated command text.

adversarial_controls.name: conflicting_runtime_rows
adversarial_controls.input: Duplicate ID, incompatible head/run/attempt, repeated step identity, or contradictory correspondence.
adversarial_controls.expected: Reject the invalid join or retain an explicit scoped conflict. No silent winner.

adversarial_controls.name: cross_variant_substitution
adversarial_controls.input: Move a command result, semantic fact, generated-script reference or native record to another variant.
adversarial_controls.expected: Reject the context mismatch or preserve the missing premise. Never complete consumption/exercise or package state across variants.

input.strategy: original MapProxy strategy, fail-fast omitted and default true
input.snapshot: controlled contrast at its explicitly recorded observation horizon; ordinary jobs retain independent outcomes

expected.failure: retain observed failure, with command outcome limited by available evidence
expected.cancelled: retain cancelled outcome; installation unknown without admissible same-context evidence
expected.unstarted: requires qualified queued/lifecycle witness at capture; assignment can remain unresolved
expected.missing: retain missing runtime evidence, never relabel it as never-started or skipped
expected.causality: configuration alone does not establish the cause of a particular cancellation

adversarial_controls.name: explicit_skip
adversarial_controls.input: Job conclusion skipped with zero step rows and an independently admitted identity basis.
adversarial_controls.expected: Retain the explicit skip. No installation execution or success credit.

adversarial_controls.name: cancelled_phase_unknown
adversarial_controls.input: Cancelled job record without reliable execution-start evidence.
adversarial_controls.expected: Outcome cancelled, start phase unknown. Empty steps or missing timestamps cannot prove never-started.

adversarial_controls.name: install_then_cancel
adversarial_controls.input: Admissible successful install-command evidence precedes a later job cancellation.
adversarial_controls.expected: Retain only independently earned command-boundary evidence. Later package use/persistence remain separate.

adversarial_controls.name: misleading_successful_shell
adversarial_controls.expected: Successful enclosing step cannot supply unsupported later-command execution. Preserve structural/profile blockers.

adversarial_controls.name: literals_and_expansion
adversarial_controls.expected: Complete admitted expansion with distinct slot and source identities, or explicit bounded unresolved result. No silent truncation or altered script.

adversarial_controls.name: historical_and_delivery
adversarial_controls.expected: Preserve historical meaning and required per-instance outcomes. Offline reading performs no acquisition or re-evaluation.

final_gate: all eight instances, adversarial controls, normal installed product, saved/native offline recovery, historical compatibility, semantic parity and full final-candidate regressions
